purpose: Reference scaffolding for Linux/server compute UCs using Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux (Splunkbase 833). Authors adapt — do not paste verbatim.

ta.name: Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux
ta.scope: Universal Forwarder on each Linux host; CIM Performance tagging via eventtypes.conf

kfps.scenario: Patch Tuesday / unattended-upgrades — CPU and disk I/O spike during package application.
kfps.distinguish: Correlate with `index=changes` or apt/yum logs in the same window.
kfps.suppress: Time-bound maintenance exception keyed on host + change ticket, not a global mute.

kfps.scenario: Nightly backup or log-rotate job — predictable I/O or CPU burst.
kfps.distinguish: Fixed cron schedule; same minute every day in `_time`.
kfps.suppress: Schedule alert outside backup window or exclude backup service account in SPL.

kfps.scenario: Synthetic monitoring probe from Nagios/Zabbix/Datadog agent.
kfps.distinguish: Source user or parent process is the monitoring agent; fixed interval.
kfps.suppress: Exclude probe service account via `where user!=monitor` or asset lookup.

kfps.scenario: New host onboarding — baseline metrics unstable first 48h.
kfps.distinguish: Asset lookup `onboarding=true` or CMDB install date within 2 days.
kfps.suppress: Filter onboarding hosts until baseline established; do not use generic operational_exceptions.csv.

troubleshooting.cause: cpu.sh input disabled or wrong index
troubleshooting.fix: Verify `[script://./bin/cpu.sh]` in inputs.conf on UF; btool check inputs
Deploy TA on SH; verify eventtype `nix_cpu_metric` and tag `performance`
